page.title: Smart Minelayer
page.t: Deploy a pattern of mines or laser towers and automatically replace destroyed items.
Delete this slot. Its laid items stay in space and are no longer replaced.
Confirm or reset the changes on this slot first.

The ship and its wingmen collect the items laid for this slot. Those not laid again go back to a station that builds them: as materials to your own station, or for its build price to another faction's station when Restock at Other Factions' Stations is on.
Delete this slot. Its laid items are collected.
Off: the ship restocks only at your own stations and supply ships, free of charge. On: it may also buy at other factions' stations, at their price.
No item of this type is available for this ship.
Cannot reach the target sector: all routes are blocked by the military blacklist.
Cannot restock after 5 attempts: no own station or supply ship, nor an allowed station of another faction, could provide it, or there were not enough credits.
Too many items: %s, at most %s per slot.
No slots and no target. Set a Target Position or Target Object in the ship's Behaviour and confirm.
Collecting the items of a deleted slot. For a new slot, set a Target Position or Target Object in the ship's Behaviour.
Keep Slots of a Destroyed Minelayer
Game hours the slots of a minelayer destroyed without wingmen are kept before they are dropped; 0 drops them at once. Its friend/foe mines keep working either way.
